thread:
maria: quick drop-in — ran a short bring-up for orca-lite-8b across int8/int6 variants. TL;DR: big cost win for int6 but a measurable longform recall dip on a small slice. can we decide routing + canary?

ajay: what are the unit economics numbers? rough deltas?

maria: sure, quick paste:```
baseline (orca-13b float): cost 1.0x, p50 210ms, p95 1.1s, longform recall 0.87
orca-lite-8b int8: cost 0.45x, p50 160ms, p95 820ms, longform recall 0.83 (-4pt)
orca-lite-8b int6: cost 0.33x, p50 150ms, p95 780ms, longform recall 0.80 (-7pt)
kv cache hit rate unchanged (~72%) across variants
examples: failing slices are ~3% of our longform summarization benchmarks (mostly topic drift + entity truncation)
```

carmen: saw same examples — 2 of them are high-variance user prompts (very long context + low signal), 1 is a factuality case where the model hallucinates an entity.

infra-bot: canary deploy started for 6890012345 at 2025-06-12T15:20:00Z :rocket:

sam: proposal: route by query-length + criticality. short queries (<300 tokens) -> int6 by default. long queries -> int8. critical product routes (answers, billing, legal FAQ) -> baseline float13b until we verify no regressions. fallback: if longform recall drops >2pt in 24h, shift long queries to int8-only or revert.

product-lead: cost is important but product won't accept >3pt hit on longform recall. if int6 is -7pt we can't ship it broadly. a 10% holdback + targeted routing sounds ok if we keep user impact traceable. need the canary signal hooks + examples surfaced to CS.

ajay: agree. what about mixed inference — run int6 for draft stage and then rerank with int8/13b on the top N responses? unit-cost math?

maria: quick back-of-envelope: rerank of top-3 with int8 adds ~0.12x cost on top of int6 baseline but recovers ~3pt recall on the failing slices in our small sample. that means end-to-end cost ~0.45x vs baseline and recall ~0.83 — similar to int8-only but saves p95 latency.

sam: that hybrid seems promising for chat/summarization pipelines. we should add a routing flag + rerank path in the canary. also add eval hooks: per-slice recall, hallucination rate, avg token cost, p95 latency.

maria: action items i can own: 1) start 48h canary with routing: short->int6, long->int8, and hybrid rerank option enabled for the summarizer route (10% traffic) 2) surface failing examples + attach eval webhook to CS 3) produce a one-pager scorecard after 48h: unit_cost_per_1M_tokens, recall_by_slice, hallucination_delta, latency_p95, kv_cache_hit

product-lead: good. include a simple decision rule in the one-pager: GA if recall delta <= 1.5pt on production slices and no increase in hallucination >0.5pt.

maria: noted — will create the canary + scoreboard and post updates here. thanks all :thumbsup:
